SUBJECT:  CITIZENS'  ADVISORY  COMMITTEE  ANNUAL  ACTION  PLAN  WORKSHOP
PRESENTED  BY  THE  HOUSING  MANAGER.

PURPOSE:  The  purpose  of this  item  is to inform  the Citizens'  Advisory  Committee  (CAC)  of the
purpose  of the Annual  Action  Plan,  public  service  and non-public  service  projects  application  process
requirements.  The  CAC  will  receive  Community  Development  Block  Grant  (CDBG)  application
packets  submitted  for service  projects  for their  review,  prior  to the March  Ist CAC  meeting.

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:  It is recommended  that the Citizens'  Advisory  Committee  consider:
  1.  Receiving  and filing  the presentation  regarding  the purpose  of the Annual  Action  Plan,  public
  service  and non-public  service  projects  application  process  requirements.

FISCAL  IMPACT:  No  fiscal  impact.

ANALYSIS:  This  workshop  is being  held  to provide  information  to the CAC  committee  members
about  the Annual  Action  Plan  requirements  and service  grants  review  process.  This  workshop  will
provide  new members  the opportunity  to learn  about  the plaru'iing  and review  process  of the CDBG
program.  It is also a good  refresher  course  to existing  legislative  body  members  and staff.  The
workshop  will  be open  to the public  in person  at the City  of South  Gate City  Hall.

BACKGROUND:  The  City,  as an entitlement  city,  receives  CDBG  funds  on an annual  basis  from
the  U.S.  Department  of  Housing  and  Urban  Development  (HUD)  to  carry  out  a wide  range  of
community  development  activities,  which  benefit  low-income  residents  and build  and develop  strong
and resilient  neighborhoods.

The City's  adopted  Citizen  Participation  Plan,  which  is a component  of the Consolidated  Plan,  requires
that members  for the CAC  be appointed  by the City  Council.  The  CAC  is an advisory  committee  to
the City  Council.  The City  Council,  by State law,  is the responsible  legislative  body  in matters  relating
to the Consolidated  Plan  and the Consolidated  Plan process.  The  CAC  may  be involved  in the review
and  evaluation  of the  programs  carried  with  CDBG  funds.  As  appropriate,  progress  or evaluation
reports  concerning  the  grant  may  be reviewed  by  the  CAC  and  recommendations  concerning  the
reports  made  to the City  Council.
